correct_completion: we bought some bread at the bakery next door.
full_sentence: The shop was closed, so we bought some bread at the bakery next door.
acceptable_variants: we went to the bakery instead.
we walked to the bakery next door.

options.text: the bread was very fresh and warm.
options.why_wrong: This describes the bread but does not show what the speaker did as a result of the shop being closed.

options.text: we bought some bread at the shop.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, because the shop was closed, so the speaker could not buy anything there.

options.text: we bought some bread at the bakery next door.

options.why_wrong: This adds a detail about the owner, but it is not a result of the shop being closed.

grammar_focus: Cause and result with 'so' and past simple
explanation: 'So' introduces a result of the first clause. The completion must describe what the speaker did as a logical consequence of the shop being closed. Ukrainian speakers sometimes choose a sentence that repeats the first clause, but a result should add new information.
translation: Магазин був зачинений, тому ми купили трохи хліба в пекарні поруч.
